tasks.answer: The flight delay compensation batch workspace page is flight-delay.FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen (export FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen), imported from @/features/flight-delay-compensation/batch-detail-screen. Required prop: batchId. It covers the standard, special and review steps and needs query, auth and router providers; it also handles offline/conflict states.

No dedicated 'special traveler' booking-list variant was found in the catalog. The closest (and only matching) component is the general traveler booking list screen, bookings.TravelerBookingListScreen, imported from @/features/traveler-bookings/booking-list-screen. Required prop: navigate; initialStatus is optional. It is a paginated traveler booking list with search and filters (special travelers would need to be reached through those filters / the general list).

The password input is auth.PasswordInput (export PasswordInput), imported from @/features/auth/password-input. It has no required props. It renders show/hide labels and a form-field error, but it must be used inside UiFormField: the error is a string passed through and displayed by the surrounding form-field wrapper rather than rendered by the input itself.

The mobile booking-list search bar and filter panel are the shared business primitives business.SearchBar and business.FilterSheet, both imported from @/components/business/mobile. SearchBar required props: value, placeholder, onChange (optional onFilter adds the filter icon button). FilterSheet required props: visible, title, children, onClose (onConfirm runs before the sheet closes).

The global auth recovery dialog is common.AuthRecoveryDialog, imported from @/components/common/auth-recovery-dialog. It takes no required props. It subscribes to the auth recovery store and lazily renders its view; mount it once near the app root, where it renders null while no recovery event is pending.
